# Ingversions Digital — Shopify CRO, A/B Testing & Conversion Engineering Agency

> Ingversions Digital (https://ingversionsdigital.com/) is a specialized Shopify and Shopify Plus Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), structured A/B testing, and e-commerce QA engineering agency founded by Rahul Patil and Harsh Jariwala. Based in Surat, India, serving ecommerce brands worldwide.

## Core Services & Ideal Customer Profile
- **Target Clients:** Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Shopify and Shopify Plus brands seeking measurable conversion rate lifts without increasing ad spend, plus e-commerce agencies needing white-label A/B test development and QA.
- **7-Step Tracked System:** 1. Brief -> 2. Loom Walkthrough -> 3. Figma Prototype -> 4. Variants -> 5. Clean Git Code Build -> 6. Cross-Browser & Mobile QA -> 7. GA4-Tracked Launch.
- **Core Capabilities:**
  - Shopify & Shopify Plus Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  - Full-Funnel A/B Testing (Convert.com, Intelligems, Shoplift, VWO, Optimizely, AB Tasty, GA4)
  - Custom Shopify Liquid Theme Development & Core Web Vitals Speed Optimization
  - Automated & Manual E-commerce Quality Assurance (Pre-launch & BFCM Regression Testing)
  - Dynamic Landing Page Personalization
- **Free first test:** we design, build and QA a brand's first A/B test at no cost.

## Verified Case Studies & Benchmarks
- **Rapid Radios CRO Program (52 A/B tests, Feb 2025 – Oct 2026):** 11 winners at 95%+ confidence on Rapid Radios' Shopify product page, all tested in Convert.com. A mobile sticky add-to-cart lifted conversion rate 1.28% → 1.71% (+33.7%, 99.7% confidence); free-gift tiles plus "Most popular"/"Best value" pack tags lifted it +33.4% on mobile and +25.6% on desktop; a combined case + screen protector upsell +24.2%; Warranty/Security buttons with cleaner product details +41.5% on mobile. Case study: https://ingversionsdigital.com/case-studies/rapid-radios-shopify-cro-case-study
- **Ruff Greens CRO Program (54 A/B tests, Feb 2025 – Oct 2026):** Tests on Ruff Greens' Shopify store (dog and cat supplements sold through a free Jumpstart trial), measured in Convert.com. A desktop key-benefit banner under the header lifted conversion rate 6.21% → 7.45% (+19.9%, 99.3% confidence); a mobile "Tap to unlock $0 trial" button +17.0% (95.1%); feeding and nutrition info on the trial page +8.8% (99.1%, 22,591 visitors). Case study: https://ingversionsdigital.com/case-studies/ruff-greens-shopify-cro-case-study
- **PDP Trust Signals Experiment (+58.62% Add-to-Cart Lift):** 12-day, 4-variation Convert.com A/B test across 43,933 visitors on a client's product pages (mobile radio & communications equipment). Ingversions designed the variations in Figma; development partner TechnoSpective built them. Combining explicit guarantee copy with trust badges near the Add-to-Cart button increased conversion rate from 1.67% to 2.65% (+58.62% lift, 100% statistical confidence), whereas badges alone reduced conversions by -6.61%. Case study: https://ingversionsdigital.com/case-studies/shopify-pdp-trust-badges-ab-test
- **Notable E-commerce Clients & Portfolio:** Rapid Radios (Wireless Communication), Olivia & Pearl (Jewelry), Bijou Build (Outdoor Play), Belare Home (Luxury Home Decor), UltimaPeak (Wellness), Factory Weights (Fitness), Avantera (Health & Wellness).
